comment: The document correctly identifies the need for an investment case and sustainability but does not provide a specific strategy for transitioning from donor-funded (project-based) models to domestically financed, service-oriented models. This transition is a critical challenge for LMICs.

anchor.note: placed on the section, by a placement agent reading the comment against the text (medium): Cites 4.6 and 4.6.2 asking for a donor-to-domestic financing transition strategy

public.text: The document correctly identifies the need for an investment case and sustainability but does not provide a specific strategy for transitioning from donor-funded (project-based) models to domestically financed, service-oriented models. This transition is a critical challenge for LMICs.
public.suggestedRevision: Add a dedicated sub-section on transition planning, including: a phased roadmap for increasing domestic financing share over time, with clear milestones; guidance on engaging Ministries of Finance as strategic partners in the design and resourcing of shared infrastructure, framed around fiscal benefits rather than technology; practical advice on designing cost-recovery and shared-benefit mechanisms; and provide examples from countries that have successfully made this transition.
